reference_sql:
WITH promo_products AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT product_id
  FROM promotion_products
)
SELECT p.brand, COUNT(*) AS n_promo_products
FROM products p
JOIN promo_products pp ON pp.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.brand
alternatives: SELECT p.brand, COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) AS n_promo_products FROM products p JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.brand

WITH promo_products AS (SELECT product_id FROM promotion_products GROUP BY product_id) SELECT p.brand, COUNT(p.product_id) AS n_promo_products FROM promo_products pp JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pp.product_id GROUP BY 1

other_way.sql: SELECT p.brand, COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) AS n_promo_products FROM products p JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.brand
other_way.tradeoff: COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) after the join is shorter and fine for a count, but it cannot repair a total the join repeats.
